description: What is the FQHC Geographic Adjustment Factor (GAF) for a place, and what does Medicare pay a Federally Qualified Health Center per visit THERE? Returns the official CMS FQHC PPS GAF for a Medicare locality and calendar year, and the GAF-adjusted per-visit rate (national base rate x GAF). Answers "FQHC PPS GAF for Orlando, Florida 2025", "CY2026 FQHC geographic adjustment Rest of California", "what is the FQHC PPS rate in Alaska". The GAF is CMS's own published number per locality (adapted from the work and practice-expense GPCIs, with the 1.0 floor), not something this tool estimates. A state returns all its localities; a city is not a locality, so name the locality or pick from the list (Florida has Fort Lauderdale, Miami and Rest of Florida). Complements medicare_fqhc_pps_rate (national base rate) and medicare_gpci_lookup (the underlying GPCIs). Years 2024-2026 loaded. Sourced from the CMS FQHC PPS geographic adjustment factor tables.

locality.description: State code ("FL"), state name ("Florida"), or Medicare locality name ("Fort Lauderdale", "Rest of Florida"). A bare state returns all of its localities.

locality_number.description: Optional Medicare locality number, e.g. "99"; with a state it pins one locality.

year.description: Calendar year, 2024-2026. Omit for the newest loaded year (stated in the response).
